records.strInstructions: One batch makes 4 portions. Preparation: 20 minutes; cooking: 45 minutes; additional resting/chilling: 75 minutes. Scrub the beetroot and place whole in a saucepan with the water. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer for 40 to 45 minutes until tender when pierced. Drain and cool until safe to handle, then rub off the skins and chop. Finely chop the walnuts, mince the garlic clove and juice the lemon. Blend the beetroot with the Greek yogurt, garlic and lemon juice until nearly smooth. Stir in the walnuts for texture. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour before serving as four side portions; no unlisted bread or crackers are included in the quantities.

records.strInstructions: One batch makes 2 portions. Preparation: 15 minutes; cooking: 20 minutes; additional resting/chilling: 0 minutes. Wash, core and thinly slice the apples. Melt 10 g of the butter in a frying pan over medium heat, add the apple, ground cinnamon and honey and cook for 7 minutes until the apples soften. Keep warm off the heat. Beat the eggs and milk in a shallow bowl. Dip each bread slice into the mixture on both sides, letting it absorb briefly without falling apart. Melt the remaining butter in a second nonstick frying pan over medium heat and fry the bread in two batches for 3 minutes per side, until golden with no liquid egg remaining. Serve two slices per person with the warm apples.

records.strInstructions: One batch makes 4 portions. Preparation: 15 minutes; cooking: 3 minutes; additional resting/chilling: 35 minutes. Chop the plain chocolate and melt gently in a small saucepan over the lowest heat for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from the heat and cool for 5 minutes. Peel the bananas; mash one and slice the other. Beat the Greek yogurt, cocoa powder and honey until smooth, then stir in the mashed banana and cooled melted chocolate. Divide among four small glasses and top with the sliced banana. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.

records.strInstructions: One batch makes 4 portions. Preparation: 5 minutes; cooking: 35 minutes; additional resting/chilling: 5 minutes. Whisk the cocoa powder with 100 ml of the milk in a heavy saucepan until smooth. Stir in the remaining milk, dry rice, honey and vanilla extract. Warm over medium heat until small bubbles form at the edges, then reduce to the lowest heat. Simmer uncovered for 30 to 35 minutes, stirring and scraping the bottom every 2 minutes, until the rice is tender and the milk has thickened. Divide among four bowls. Cool for 5 minutes before serving warm; the pudding thickens further as it stands.
